lena: Quick note from onboarding Garnet-7B (int4) on staging: long-generation tests show gradual phase decay in attention after ~900 tokens, outputs become bland/repetitive. Repro below.

lena: repro: ```./redwood-eval --model garnet-7b-int4 --prompt-file tests/long_gen_seed.json --max-tokens 2500 --kvcache --quant int4 --seed 42```

arpit: can you dump rotary params and tokenizer mapping? could be phase scaling mismatch or a token normalization issue.

lena: attached a snippet: `rotary: { mode: shared, base: 10000, scale: 1.0001 }` and tokenizer claims NFKC normalizer enabled. Model export meta lists head_dim=32 but binary weights imply 64 per head (weird).

dave: head_dim mismatch is suspicious. If export metadata reports half the head_dim, our kvcache stride could be off by factor 2 leading to reads from previous head slots.

lena: here's a small kvcache index trace around decay point: `kvcache_pos[892..908] -> token_ids [55,102,17,72,55,102,17,72,....]` after 900 it starts reading earlier head lanes.

deploy-bot: staging/garnet-7b-int4 deploy at 7065432098 by infra-runner. Smoke tests: unit=ok, perf=ok, longgen=flaky.

arpit: is runtime using per-head interleave? we recently added an optimization for half-head packing on Ampere that assumes contiguous head blocks. If metadata is wrong that pack/unpack will misalign.

lena: runtime log shows `kernel: pack_half_head=true` selected due to GPU capability. Turning that off with `--no-pack-half-head` improves output in quick test.

dave: so two issues: wrong head_dim in export, and runtime aggressive packing. Both need fixes: exporter should set correct head_dim and include a `pack_hint` flag; runtime should validate head_dim and refuse incompatible pack modes.

arpit: also check tokenizer NFKC: if normalization changes byte length, kv positions based on byte offsets vs token indexes could diverge. But seems secondary here.

lena: ran fp16 vs int4 logits parity checkpoints at 500-token intervals. fp16 stable; int4 drifts only when pack_half_head=true and head_dim mismatch present. With pack disabled parity matches within epsilon.

ci-bot: test-note: nightly-parity-run failed for garnet-7b-int4 at 7065432000 on pack_half_head enabled.

dave: plan: 1) quick runtime guard that checks head_dim * num_heads == weight_dim and aborts on mismatch with clear error; 2) exporter patch to compute and write head_dim correctly and populate pack_hint; 3) backfill sanitizer to scan S3 exports and tag likely-broken artifacts; 4) add a short onboarding checklist item for head_dim/tokenizer sanity.

arpit: I'll own runtime guard + kernel fallback (2-3 hours). lena can open exporter PR and sanitizer. dave can add the checklist + unit test for parity.

lena: starting exporter PR now. I'll include a test that loads the binary and compares inferred head_dim to metadata and fails export if inconsistent.

dave: also add a small micro-benchmark to CI that toggles pack_half_head and verifies no regressions on small input.

lena: thanks. tagging ops to run a quick S3 scan for exports with head_dim < 40 (suspicious) and flag for manual review.

arpit: good catch. Without this we could ship subtle long-context regressions in int4 only.

lena: will post PR links when ready. Keeping canary paused until runtime guard merges. :eyes:
